hooks.command: case "$TOOL_INPUT" in *'git commit'*) npm run build --silent 2>&1 | tail -20 ;; *) true ;; esac
hooks.description: Verify production build succeeds before committing

hooks.command: case "$TOOL_INPUT" in *.tsx|*.ts) npx tsc --noEmit --strict 2>&1 | tail -10 || true ;; *) true ;; esac
hooks.description: Run TypeScript check after editing .ts/.tsx files
